text:
Maria G: Heads-up 1: I'm drafting a short FAQ entry to clarify how cooldown timers behave during tenant draining for Dedicated pools. customers are misreading examples and assuming timers pause.

Jonah K: Yep saw that in support yesterday. we should be explicit: cooldown keeps counting even if instances are marked draining.

Shiv P: Confirming from runtime: we do not stop the cooldown clock today. there is an opt-in flag graceful_scale that reduces wasted preemption by delaying the heavy eviction step, but it does NOT extend cooldown.

Eli S: Could we include a tiny matrix? like 2 columns: graceful_scale on/off vs hold_for present/absent -> outcome. Support likes quick matrices.

Maria G: good idea. keeping it micro. also include a YAML snippet and a cli one-liner + python SDK call so users can copy.

Maria G: YAML example I'm proposing:
```yaml
scalePolicy:
  cooldown: 300s
  graceful_scale: true  # opt-in: delays eviction but does not pause cooldown
  hold_for: tenant-drain
```

Maria G: CLI one-liner:
`rwctl pool patch --id $POOL --set scalePolicy.cooldown=300s --set scalePolicy.graceful_scale=true`

Maria G: Python SDK snippet:
```python
from redwood import DedicatedClient
client = DedicatedClient()
client.update_scale_policy(pool_id, cooldown=300, graceful_scale=True)
```

Jonah K: Wording suggestion for the FAQ sentence: "Note: cooldown timers continue to run while instances drain; enabling graceful_scale reduces unnecessary preemption but does not extend the cooldown period." short + clear.

Shiv P: +1. i'll add a one-line runtime note to the PR review: graceful_scale prevents immediate eviction of warm instances to preserve KV, but autoscale timers are unchanged.

Eli S: I'll add the little 2x2 matrix to the examples index after merge. keeps support happy.

Maria G: thanks bot. quick followup: link-checker flagged docs/dedicated/sla.md as stale in CI. i'll point it to /docs/dedicated/sla/commitments.md in the PR.

Jonah K: Also consider adding a short note under "Dedicated SLA -> capacity" clarifying that time during tenant drains counts toward capacity commitments. customers misinterpret otherwise.

Shiv P: Good call. i'll review that section and leave a suggestion in the PR.

Maria G: Action items: (1) me: push YAML/CLI/SDK + 2x2 matrix + small FAQ line, (2) Shiv: runtime phrasing review, (3) Jonah: SLA cross-ref check, (4) Eli: add to examples index after merge. aiming to merge today.
